roll_calls.question: On Motion to Recommit — Farm, Food, and National Security Act (H R 7567)
roll_calls.plain_language: H.R. 7567 (Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026) reauthorizes through FY2031 and modifies Department of Agriculture programs (the farm bill), including commodity support, conservation, nutrition assistance, farm credit, rural development, forestry, and crop insurance. A motion to recommit is the minority's last formal chance to send a bill back to committee before the passage vote. A Yea supports sending it back; a Nay keeps it on the floor for the passage vote.

post.text:
When families go to the grocery store, they feel the cost. The price of food is simply too high and our farmers are struggling under rising costs.

That is why I voted for H.R. 7567, the Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026, which passed the House. Our farmers feed America, create jobs, and keep eastern North Carolina's agriculture-based economy strong. The Senate must act so we can get a Farm Bill to the President's desk. We have waited long enough.
